# FluffOS

> High-performance LPMUD driver (LPC compiler, VM, Telnet/WebSocket/TLS).
> Docs: https://www.fluffos.info
> Source: https://github.com/fluffos/fluffos
> Org: https://github.com/fluffos

Onboarding contract for language models:

https://www.fluffos.info/llm

STOP. Ask the user which mudlib to work on before cloning or booting.
Do not boot fluffos/fluffos/testsuite/ unless they are changing the driver.

Mudlib AGENTS.md template (copy into the chosen lib):
https://www.fluffos.info/mudlib-agents

Human twin: https://www.fluffos.info/start
Glossary (MudOS, LPMUD, LPC): https://www.fluffos.info/lpmud
Ecosystem: https://www.fluffos.info/ecosystem
Chinese game catalog (browser): https://mudlibs.fluffos.info/

- https://www.fluffos.info/llm

## Source of truth (driver repo)

- src/packages/*/*.spec — efun signatures
- src/vm/internal/applies — apply names
- src/base/internal/rc.cc — config keys
- AGENTS.md — C++ / driver-contributor contract
- testsuite/ — driver LPC suite only
